name: Round Rock Lifeguard Training and Seasonal Aquatics Jobs
org: City of Round Rock Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take a lifeguard class, then work as a lifeguard at city pools. The city also hires pool attendants, swim teachers and cashiers. There is a path from pool attendant to lifeguard.
who_can_apply: Must be 15 or older before the last class. Must pass a swim test: swim 150 yards, tread water 2 minutes, then swim 50 yards, and retrieve a 10 pound object from 7 to 10 feet.
pay_detail: Lifeguard pay shown as $15 to $19.50 per hour (from a graphic on the page; a separate rate sheet is the official source). Training costs $215 to $305, or $75 if you sign a full season work commitment. Scholarships are available.
duration: Seasonal summer job. Training classes run November to May.
deadline_text: No application deadline is listed. The 2026 classes ran Mar 16 to May 30, 2026. 2027 class dates are not posted on the page I read.
how_to_apply: Sign up for training at roundrockrecreation.com. Then apply for jobs on the city job portal. To get the $75 rate, email the signed Commitment Letter to pardcustomerservice@roundrocktexas.gov. Call 512-218-5540 with questions.
notes: It is smart to apply early. If you pass the class, you get Lifeguard, CPR/AED and First Aid cards. They are good for 2 years. You must come to every class.
